convergence.title: Convergence
convergence.description: Where two repositories reached the same conclusion independently — read them and decide. The knowledge half's lead view.
convergence.hintSemantic: Lower it to see weaker overlaps. Worth sweeping rather than trusting one number — the right value depends on the corpus.
convergence.hintLexical: Without an embedding endpoint this finds copies and restatements only. Two repositories that reached the same conclusion in different words will not appear.
convergence.emptyBody: A lower similarity finds weaker likenesses — and, lower still, documents that only share words.
convergence.emptyFloor: {{value}} is the lowest it goes: below it, two documents would only share words. Nothing here converges.
convergence.methods.Convergent.label: Same lesson, different words
convergence.methods.Convergent.hint: The finding no text comparison can make — and the reason the semantic tier exists.
convergence.methods.Restatement.label: Substantially the same words
convergence.methods.Restatement.hint: Usually a copy that has since drifted.
convergence.methods.Identical.label: The same document, pasted
convergence.cappedAt: first {{count}} — more found, so raise the similarity
